ws.hero_subtitle: Don't have a website? No problem. Our team designs and develops modern, high-converting websites exclusively for escape room businesses — so you can focus on what you do best.
ws.why_subtitle: In today's digital world, your website is your storefront. Here's what you're missing without one.
ws.why_stat1_label: of customers search online before visiting an escape room
ws.why_stat2_label: more bookings with a professional online presence
ws.why_stat3_label: your website works around the clock, even when you sleep
ws.included_subtitle: Every website we build comes packed with everything an escape room business needs.
ws.inc_design_desc: A unique, branded design that reflects your escape room's identity and atmosphere.
ws.inc_responsive_desc: Fully responsive and optimized for phones, tablets, and desktops.
ws.inc_seo_desc: Built-in search engine optimization so customers can find you on Google.
ws.inc_speed_desc: Optimized performance with fast loading times for a better user experience.
ws.inc_ssl_desc: Free SSL certificate and secure hosting to protect your data and customers.
ws.inc_booking_desc: UNLOCKED booking widget pre-installed — customers book directly from your site.
ws.inc_domain_desc: We help you choose and configure your domain name (e.g., yourescaperoom.com).
ws.inc_support_desc: Continuous support for as long as you're on UNLOCKED — bug fixes, content updates, and questions answered.
ws.pricing_subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your business. No hidden fees, no surprises.
ws.plan1_desc: Perfect for new escape rooms that need an online presence quickly.
ws.plan2_desc: For established businesses wanting a full-featured website.
ws.plan3_desc: The complete digital package for premium escape room brands.
ws.maintenance_desc: Need ongoing updates? We offer monthly maintenance plans starting at €49/month — including content updates, security patches, hosting, and technical support. Everything in one package.
ws.process_subtitle: From first contact to launch — here's our streamlined 5-step process.
ws.step_consultation_desc: We discuss your business, brand, goals, and requirements. We'll understand what makes your escape room unique.
ws.step_design_phase_desc: Our designers create visual mockups for your approval. We iterate until you are 100% satisfied with the look and feel.
ws.step_development_desc: We build your website with clean, modern code. Fully responsive, fast, and SEO-ready from the ground up.
ws.step_review_desc: You review the website live. We make up to 3 rounds of revisions to fine-tune every detail.
ws.step_launch_desc: Domain configured, SSL active, analytics set up — your website goes live. We celebrate together! 🎉
ws.total_time_desc: 3–5 weeks from start to launch (Starter: ~2 weeks, Professional: ~3–4 weeks, Premium: ~5 weeks)
ws.need_subtitle: To build you the perfect website, we'll need a few things from your side.
ws.need_brand_info_desc: Your logo, brand colors, fonts, and any branding guidelines you already have.
ws.need_photos_desc: High-quality photos of your rooms, team, and venue. We can also arrange professional photography.
ws.need_content_desc: Room descriptions, pricing, operating hours, location, and any other text. We can help write it too.
ws.need_domain_req_desc: Your preferred domain name (e.g., myescaperoom.gr). We'll check availability and help you register it.
ws.need_payment_desc: 50% upfront to start, 50% on launch. We accept bank transfer and card payments.
ws.need_note: Don't have everything ready? No worries — we'll guide you through every step.
ws.faq1_q: How long does it take to build my website?
ws.faq1_a: Typically 2–5 weeks depending on the plan. Starter sites can be ready in about 2 weeks, while Premium packages take around 5 weeks.
ws.faq2_q: Do I need to provide content and images?
ws.faq2_a: Ideally yes, but we can help! We offer content writing assistance and can arrange professional photography for an additional fee.
ws.faq3_q: Will my website work on mobile devices?
ws.faq3_a: Absolutely. Every website we build is fully responsive and tested across all devices — phones, tablets, and desktops.
ws.faq4_q: Can I update the website myself after launch?
ws.faq4_a: Yes, we provide a simple content management system or you can request changes through our maintenance plan.
ws.faq5_a: The first year of hosting is included with every plan. After that, you can choose standalone hosting at €9/month (or €89/year), or get our maintenance plan at €49/month which includes hosting plus content updates, security patches, and technical support.
ws.faq6_q: Can you add the UNLOCKED booking system to my existing website?
ws.faq6_a: Yes! The UNLOCKED booking widget is available for free in your company dashboard under Settings. Simply copy the embed code and paste it into your website — no custom development needed.
ws.faq7_q: What if I'm not satisfied with the design?
ws.faq7_a: We include multiple rounds of design revisions. We won't launch until you're 100% happy with the result.
ws.cta_subtitle: Get in touch today for a free, no-obligation quote. Let us build the website your escape room deserves.

seo.what_p1: UNLOCKED is your gateway to the most thrilling puzzle adventures, wherever you are. Browse rooms, compare themes and difficulty levels, read verified player reviews, and book your next experience in seconds — all from one platform.
seo.what_p2: Whether you are a first-timer looking for a fun team outing or a seasoned enthusiast chasing your next challenge, UNLOCKED makes it easy to find exactly what you are looking for. Filter by location, price, group size, and more to discover the perfect room for your crew.
seo.players_discover_p: Explore a curated collection of puzzle rooms filtered by theme, difficulty, location, price, and player reviews. From spine-chilling horror scenarios to mind-bending mystery puzzles, UNLOCKED showcases the most exciting experiences in every city we cover. Each listing includes detailed descriptions, photos, ratings, duration, and real reviews — so you always know what to expect.
seo.players_book_p: No more phone calls or uncertainty. Reserve your spot in seconds: pick your preferred date and time, select the number of players, complete your payment securely, and receive instant confirmation with your booking code. The process is seamless on desktop or mobile.
seo.players_social_p: UNLOCKED is more than booking. Share your stories on the social feed, compete on the leaderboard, earn achievement badges, and connect with other enthusiasts. Track your history, rate the rooms you have visited, and discover trending experiences across the country.
seo.why_point1: Rooms to explore in cities around the world, with new ones added as venues join.
seo.why_point2: Instant online booking with secure payment processing.
seo.why_point3: Verified reviews and ratings from real players.
seo.why_point4: Instant booking confirmation with a unique booking code.
seo.why_point5: Social features: leaderboard, badges, and a player community.
seo.why_point6: Filter by location, theme, difficulty, price, and group size.
seo.start_p: Ready to find your next adventure? Sign up for free, explore rooms near you, and see how UNLOCKED helps players everywhere discover, book, and share unforgettable experiences.
